correctness.rationale: For any admissible symmetric design the incidence matrix identity NN^T=(k-lambda)I+lambda J implies dual pair intersections lambda. All eight ordered pair sorts/equality/incidence types admit exactly the same third-element support: lambda>0, k-lambda>0, v-2k+lambda=(v-k)(v-k-1)/(v-1)>0, and the mixed incident/nonincident counts k-1,k,v-k,v-k-1 are positive. Thus the three-pebble back-and-forth invariant persists after every move for arbitrary depth, implying FO^3 equivalence. In the Fano/complement pair lambda=1 versus 2 yields no 4-cycle versus 21, a valid FO^4 witness. Two independently organized finite programs corroborate the table and stable pebble colours.

value.rationale: A complete three-variable theory is identified across a natural, structurally diverse class containing projective planes, complementary planes and higher biplanes, despite changes in size, degrees and pair-intersection lambda. A sharp four-variable separation on equally sized fourteen-vertex graphs makes the expressive-resource boundary precise and distinguishes unbounded depth from variable width. This is a structural first-order limitation, not a routine finite test or arbitrary parameter slice.
